title: kb_mcp tests fail in CI when main moved after the pipeline's commit
goal: test_kb_mcp.py's tests that run kb_pack on the checkout (TestKbServer::test_kb_pack_audit_facts_cited, test_domain_is_matched_without_case_and_an_unknown_one_is_refused) pass whatever the checkout's upstream holds: they run with the behind notice off (an environment switch kb_mcp.behind_note honours, KB_NO_UPSTREAM=1) or strip it, and test_status_says_how_far_a_clone_is_behind_its_remote still proves the notice.
notes: kb-tests-windows job 16794362441 (pipeline 2891453375, commit 4f99ec627) ran all tests and failed only these two: the runner fetched origin/main 7 commits past the pipeline's commit (the query log's automatic pushes), so kb_pack opened with `kb copy: 7 commits behind origin/main` before `coverage:`. Any CI job on a commit main has moved past fails them, on every OS. It blocks TK-23djaz5l, which needs a successful kb-tests-windows job.
